title: Source restriction along a Reedy cofibration of frames is a Kan fibration
statement: Use model categories, cofibrant and fibrant objects, cosimplicial frames, their simplicial function complexes $H$, and Kan fibrations as in [lem-coef-cosimplicial-frame-mapping], and Reedy cofibrations as in [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. Let $\mathcal M$ be any model category with functorial factorizations. Let $A^\bullet\to\operatorname{const}A$ and $B^\bullet\to\operatorname{const}B$ be cosimplicial frames on cofibrant objects $A,B$. Let $u^\bullet:A^\bullet\to B^\bullet$ be a Reedy cofibration, and suppose the augmentations commute with a map $u:A\to B$, with $u^0=u$. For every fibrant object $Y$, restriction is a Kan fibration of Kan complexes $$H(B^\bullet,Y)\xrightarrow{(u^\bullet)^*}H(A^\bullet,Y),\qquad H(X^\bullet,Y)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(X^n,Y).$$ This assertion holds for every such augmented pair of frames, and is natural in maps of augmented pairs and in maps between fibrant targets. No simplicial enrichment, properness, or combinatorial hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Hovey, Model categories, Proposition 5.4.3, printed pp.130-131 (PDF pp.139-140), specialized to a simplicial horn inclusion and adjointed against Y→1. Proposition 5.4.1 supplies cofibrancy of the corner map; Corollary 5.4.4 supplies the Kan complexes. Read online in this repair. No Stacks tag states this general model-category result; WANTED: archive this source in literature/.
